scripts.predev: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix backend --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-frontend-dist.mjs && npm run build --prefix backend
